    StartersLiar's dice halloumi with chilli honeyPan-fried halloumi cubes with warm chilli honey, lemon and thymeHow to make it360g halloumi, cut into 2cm cubes2 tbsp plain flour3 tbsp olive oil4 tbsp honey1 tsp chilli flakes1 lemon1 tsp thyme leavesPat the halloumi cubes dry and toss in the flour.Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 1 minute a side until golden all over. Warm the honey with the chilli flakes.Pile into a cup, tip onto a board like a throw of dice, and drizzle with chilli honey, lemon and thyme.Pelegosto island skewersPork and pineapple skewers glazed with chilli lime honey, grilled over coalsHow to make it500g pork scotch fillet, cut into chunks1/2 pineapple, cut into chunks3 tbsp honey1 red chilli, chopped2 limes, juicedThread the pork and pineapple onto skewers.Warm the honey with the chilli and lime juice.Grill over hot coals, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred on all sides.Tia Dalma's chicken and sausage gumboTia Dalma's hut up the swamp riverHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken and smoky sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, celery and onion, ladled over rice with spring onion.Stir 80ml oil and 80g plain flour in a heavy pot over medium heat for 20 minutes until the roux is dark brown.Add 1 diced onion, 1 green capsicum and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes.Add 500g diced chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, 2 tsp Cajun spice and 1L chicken stock.Simmer for 45 minutes, adding 200g sliced okra for the last 15.Serve in cups over 300g cooked rice with sliced spring onion.Hush puppies with cane syrup butterJack's jar of dirt sits on the table.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDavy Jones's seafood boilPotatoes, corn, prawns and mussels boiled with paprika, garlic and lemon, garlic butterHow to make it800g baby potatoes1 tbsp smoked paprika4 garlic cloves, 2 in the water and 2 crushed for the butter1 lemon, halved4 corn cobs, halved500g green prawns1kg mussels, cleaned150g butter, meltedBoil the potatoes in salted water with the paprika, garlic and lemon.Add the corn and cook for 5 minutes.Add the prawns and mussels for 4 minutes until the mussels open.Drain, tip onto paper and pour over melted butter mixed with the crushed garlic.Tortuga jerk chicken with rice and peasRecruiting a crew in Tortuga, Jack doing the pickingHow to make it1kg chicken thighs, bone in4 spring onions1 Scotch bonnet or red chilli1 tsp ground allspice4 sprigs of thyme2 tbsp soy sauce1 lime300g long grain rice400ml coconut milk400g tin kidney beans, drainedBlitz the spring onion, chilli, allspice, thyme leaves, soy and lime juice and rub over the chicken.Grill or roast at 200°C until charred and cooked through.Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, 250ml water and salt, covered, until tender.SweetsKraken ink chocolate tartDark chocolate ganache tart with sea salt flakes on a cocoa pastryHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry1 tbsp cocoa300g dark chocolate, chopped300ml thickened creamsea salt flakes, to tasteRub the cocoa into the pastry, line a tart tin and blind bake at 180°C. Cool.Heat the cream and pour over the chocolate, stirring until glossy.Pour into the case and chill overnight.Sprinkle with sea salt flakes before slicing.DrinksTia Dalma's hibiscus ginger sorrelChilled hibiscus, ginger and clove drink over ice, dark rum for adultsHow to make it30g dried hibiscus flowers1 knob ginger, sliced4 cloves1 orange, peeled into strips1.2 L boiling water120g caster sugar60ml dark rum, optional for the grown-ups1 bag iceSteep the hibiscus, ginger, cloves and orange peel in the boiling water for 30 minutes.Strain, stir in the sugar and chill.Serve over ice, with a splash of dark rum for the grown-ups.Spiced rum and ginger beerOrdered while Tia Dalma eyes the black spot.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
